anchors.action: Keep original front standing posture. Gently look down at crescent brooch, ears relaxed; this is breathing anticipation, not a spellcasting stance.

Exactly four legs, no floating cat. View-correct side cape, crescent brooch partially occluded, RIGHT wrist cuff on correct anatomical leg.

Side cape constructed for this view; anatomical RIGHT wrist cuff on far foreleg only, occluded if appropriate, never switch to near left foreleg.

Completion kiss anticipation: lift anatomical RIGHT forepaw (viewer LEFT) close to muzzle, eyes gently narrowing warmly, left forepaw grounded, both hind legs attached/supporting. Raised paw replaces grounded right counterpart. The wrist cuff remains on raised wrist.

Spell gathering: seated on two hind paws, BOTH real forepaws lifted and cupped inward facing one another below chest brooch, elbows bent; gaze focuses between paws; no remaining grounded front paws. Exactly four attached legs.

Magical jewel inspection: seated, anatomical RIGHT forepaw delicately touches round pearl of crescent brooch, head and blue eyes bow toward it; left front paw supports ground, two hind legs support hips. Cape bends around raised shoulder.

Moonlit magical rest: curled prone on right side facing viewer-right, eyes closed, head rests on two attached tucked forepaws, two hind legs folded under torso with named torso occlusion, tail curls around body. Crescent brooch and petal cape follow side/prone chest construction, no frontal hanging bib; ear bows remain attached.
Same original front standing proportions and ground support as idle; slow closed-eye blink and small relaxed head nod toward crescent brooch. All four legs attached.

Spell presentation peak: seated on two hind paws, BOTH front legs lifted opening outward, paws up and softly extended toward viewer to present heart magic, chest open; focused blue eyes lift toward viewer. No grounded forepaw duplicates. Right cuff on viewer-left raised wrist.

Completion blown kiss release: right front paw extends forward/up away from muzzle with paw opening, head follows a little and eyes warm; left front paw grounded, hind legs support. Exactly four legs. Right cuff travels with extended wrist.

Magical leap airborne peak: both front legs spread outward at shoulder height to release magic, two hind legs tuck under belly, all four limbs attached; cape panels lifted by momentum, ear ribbon ends trail down, single tail curves down-right. Same original head size, body scale; only vertical jump height changes.

Spell recovery reassurance: seated on two hind paws, both front paws curve inward gently around dangling heart pendant, eyes tender and determined, shoulders relax. Exactly four attached legs, front ground counterparts absent.

Invitation resolution: seated hind support, both real front paws come together at lower chest in small hopeful clasp, head tilts toward viewer, soft blue eyes. Preserve cape and crescent unobstructed, four attached limbs.
